name: Sharable Link
description:
Sharable lets you publish your Claude creations — reports, dashboards, landing pages, proposals, any HTML page — to a public link in seconds. Just ask Claude to share it, and you get a URL you can send to anyone. Update a page later without changing its link, add a password when something's private, or take it down whenever you want. Whoever you send it to just opens it in their browser — no Claude account needed.

Share a page — turn any HTML Claude makes into a public link.
Update a page — change the content while keeping the same URL.
Remove a page — take down anything you've shared, anytime.
Password-protect — gate private pages behind a password.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sharable Link to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sharable Link to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://sharable.link/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sharable Link MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sharable Link provides these MCP tools: share_html, unshare_page, update_page, and list_my_pages.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sharable Link?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Sharable Link in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Sharable Link MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sharable Link requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Sharable Link is developed by BotsCrew. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
